description: "Christian Gellert's Last Christmas" by Berthold Auerbach is a narrative fiction piece written in the mid-19th century. Set in the historical backdrop of 1768 in Leipzig, the story centers on Christian Furchtegott Gellert, a beloved poet and moralist.
